messages:
mike_support: FYI — getting multiple customer reports of /v1/rerank 502/504s and gateway timeouts. Started ~12:03 UTC, p95 for rerank jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s. Affected customers are on Hosted tier and some Dedicated lanes. Request IDs: rid=cr-9a2c, cr-9a7f, cr-9b11.

jess_support: Logged inbound tickets and repro attempts. Customers sending large candidate lists (~1200 items) in some batches. One customer says they didn't change client code. Attaching anonymized sample payload.

mike_support: Repro steps we used: curl to /v1/rerank with candidates array length 1200, qps ~80 for a minute. Observed gateway 504s and backend 5xx.

omar_eng_runtime: Can you paste the anonymized payload + exact headers? Need to check batching behavior + tokenization explosion. Also what model variant was selected?

jess_support: Payload snippet: ```json
{"query":"find matching docs","candidates":["id1","id2",...,"id1200"],"max_results":50}
``` Headers: content-type:application/json, x-client:customer-42, model:rerank-v2.1.

liz_eng_sre: We see gateway timeouts correlated with a spike in backend latency and an increase in retry churn from the gateway. SRE graphs show worker CPU pegged and a drop in successful KV cache hits during the window — suggests cache thrash + oversized fanout.

dan_platform: Noting that rerank-v2.1 has a tighter per-request CPU budget. If candidate lists go much above 512 we fall into a slow path that allocates more memory and makes many small attention calls. Could be the regression here.

omar_eng_runtime: That matches. When candidates >> typical size, we do per-candidate scoring serially in some codepaths. Two possible mitigations: 1) throttle candidate count at the gateway (quick fix), 2) route oversized requests to an async worker pool with higher concurrency (medium).

mike_support: Customer impact: intermittent timeouts, some requests returning 502 with no reranked output. Billing calls show retries causing duplicate billing attempts — billing team flagged potential overcharges.

jess_support: For immediate mitigation we told affected customers to reduce candidate list to <=256. Two customers confirmed reduced errors. But customers want platform fix.

liz_eng_sre: Short term action: enable gateway-side candidate_count cap for rerank (config push). Also increase the circuit-breaker threshold to avoid retry storms and set automatic 429 for oversized payloads. Will push soft cap 512 and hard reject >2048.

infra-bot: deploy queued: gateway-config#2026 will apply rule: if rerank.candidates > 512 -> soft throttle; >2048 -> 413 reject. Target rollout: canary 10% then 100% in 6m.

omar_eng_runtime: I'll investigate the serial scoring slow path and add batching within the runtime to avoid O(n) per-candidate overhead. Assigning a patch: reduce per-candidate kernel launches by grouping candidates into vectorized scores. ETA: investigation today, patch tomorrow.

dan_platform: Also looking at autoscale headroom for Dedicated pools — we saw reserved capacity starve because of a mis-sized burst policy. I'll temporarily expand burst quota for the next 2 hours to relieve pressure.

mike_support: Can we also surface more descriptive 4xx for oversized payloads so clients can self-correct? Right now gateway returns 504/502 which is confusing.

liz_eng_sre: Yes will change rej code to 413 + helpful body that includes candidate_count and link to guidance.

jess_support: I'm drafting a customer note with repro steps, a recommended immediate mitigation snippet, and timeline for platform fixes.

mike_support: Example mitigation snippet we sent customers: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"query":"...","candidates": client_candidates.slice(0,256)}'
```

omar_eng_runtime: Follow-ups: (1) collect a few representative large payloads and sample traces (trace ids above). (2) add unit/scale test for candidate_count 1k-2k. (3) consider optimizing the model scoring kernel for long fanouts.

liz_eng_sre: Post-mitigation observation: after gateway cap applied to 10% canary, error rate for rerank requests dropped from 8% -> 1.2% in that cohort, backend p95 improved ~30%. Will monitor next 30m before full rollout.

mike_support: Thanks team. I'll keep the thread updated with customer confirmations and billing remediation requests. If anyone gets a critical trace or repro payload, drop it here.

jess_support: Adding links to ticket numbers and a short FAQ once we confirm full rollout success. :white_check_mark:
